hook.name: RarityHook
hook.description: A hook for Yunipals rarity pools that enforces two invariants: only the core contract may initialize pools or add liquidity (external LPs are blocked via beforeInitialize/beforeAddLiquidity), and 1% of the output side of every external exact-input swap is burned via afterSwap return delta. Includes a permissionless TWAP oracle updated on every swap.
